parent_objective: design fresh source-holdout replay for M761 residual head

public_gates: M766 designs a fresh source-holdout replay plan
M766 explicitly avoids using M755 assigned_split heldout as unbiased holdout
M766 prioritizes alpha 0.2 and treats 0.5 1.0 as diagnostics
M766 defines fallback to fresh v4 source mining if existing artifacts are insufficient
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M755 assigned_split heldout as unbiased holdout
do not train residual or actor parameters
do not tune alpha from holdout and call it unbiased
do not claim true four-wheel or single-wheel physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_generalization: test M761 residual on fresh source rows
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a no-PPO source-holdout replay after M764 public-corpus closed-loop positive
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no holdout result, PPO claim, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if no fresh source rows can be identified
stop if design relies on M755 assigned_split heldout as unbiased
stop if design admits residual retraining or PPO
stop if normal-retention and intervention-sensitivity metrics are missing
fallback_plan: if existing artifacts do not contain enough fresh rows, design a fresh v4 reset-source wave
if source rows are too concentrated, source-balance by seed fault family variant and horizon
if alpha 0.2 is too weak on holdout, report negative and audit before trying stronger alpha
if alpha 1.0 is too aggressive, keep it diagnostic only

hypothesis: A fresh source-holdout replay can be designed to test whether the M761 residual closed-loop signal generalizes beyond the public M755/M761 corpus.
success_criteria: M766 defines what counts as fresh relative to M761
M766 defines source selection and fallback source-mining plan
M766 defines alpha set and conservative primary alpha
M766 defines normal retention and intervention sensitivity gates
M766 blocks training PPO and promotion
failure_criteria: design uses contaminated assigned_split heldout as unbiased
design treats holdout as promotion gate
decision_rule: M766 may only design a source-holdout replay or fresh source-mining fallback. It must not train, run PPO, mutate actor parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
